text: 📣 Devon stood down Sweeps Week and kept walking. 4 rounds, 30 taken.
⚔ SWEEPS WEEK! Beibit, Desmond join you!
The Sweeps Week is on you — no warning, just teeth.
Beibit SCREAMS — a sound like milk curdling in fast-forward. The The Sweeps Week freezes. (stunned)

Sanne leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Sweeps Week. Never show it your back. FACE IT — or paint eyes on the back of your head — and it hesitates. It wants the ambush, not the fight. Never turn, never run; running is prey. Hold its gaze and back away slow."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sweeps Week: Never show it your back. FACE IT — or paint eyes on the back of your head — and it hesitates. It wants the ambush, not the fight. Never turn, never run; running is prey. Hold its gaze and back away slow. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
On the carcass nearby, Sweeps Week (carcass), Bulldozer (carcass), Ugly-Eyes (carcass) went bad — maggots, smell, the whole sad story. Leaving it had a cost.
